truth.description: generateCodeFrame now throws a RangeError for a position past the end of its source, and the plugin container's transform still sends every hook error through ctx.error to formatError, which frames a postcss error from an @import-ed file against the importing file's shorter code, so a CSS syntax error deep in an imported file reaches the dev server as that RangeError instead of the CSS error.

distractions.why: An esbuild message location carries a 1-based line and a 0-based column, the shape generateCodeFrame reads as a line and column position, so its extra fields are ignored and the caret lands on the reported character.
